sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0011_seraph_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0011_seraph_* (game 1.6, commit 535e88f), as compiled by efsim kit-draft (skillCompile.ts) and completed by hand where noted: the Auxiliary Crystal (a buff → ability entity → aura → per-member listener chain the compiler reports only as notes), the talent-1 branch of the combo, and the ultimate's Amp. Frames are SkillData frames (30 FPS) from the cast; projectile hits land at their launch frame (travel isn't in the data: Ti2, in-game test 47). Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0011_seraph.md (gap report, kit plan and the section "Kit").

Values: SkillPatchTable chr_0011_seraph_* at the build's skill levels (level 12: attacks 1-5 atk_scale 0.34 / 0.36 / 0.47 / 0.37 per landing / 1.24, attack5 poise 15 and atb 15; finisher 9.0; dive 1.8; battle skill cost 100 SP, atk_up 0.15, buff_duration 25, duration 20; combo atk_scale 4.5, poise 10, usp 10, cooldown 7 s; ultimate atk_up 0.24, wisd_up 0.0003, wisd_max 0.36, duration 12, cost 80, cooldown 20 s). Talents (PotentialTalentEffectTable chr_0011_seraph_talent_1_1..2_2) only set blackboard keys: talent 1 the combo's cryst_up (0.07 / 0.10) and duration (5) and exist_talent_1, talent 2 the ultimate's exist_talent_2. Potentials: P1 battle skill atk_up +0.05; P2 ultimate cost ×0.9; P3 the combo's bounce to a second enemy (no effect against one); P4 Intellect +15 and Treatment Efficiency +10% (stat panel); P5 ultimate atk_up, wisd_up and wisd_max ×1.1.

Not kit skills: chr_0011_seraph_dash_attack (+ _projhit, _projhit02) and chr_0011_seraph_extra_attack (+ _projhit) (dash attacks aren't modelled: S5, deferred), chr_0011_seraph_dodge, chr_0011_seraph_tactic_skill and buff_chr_0011_seraph_tactic_atb (not in CharGrowthTable skillGroupMap nor SkillPatchTable: not castable), chr_0011_seraph_talent_0/1/2 and buff_chr_0011_seraph_talent_0/1/1_atb/2/2_phydown (no talent node attaches them), so the battle skill's frame-6 SP (IfElse CheckBuffStackNum buff_chr_0011_seraph_talent_1_atb ≥ 1, which kit-draft reports) never happens. The listeners normal_skill_listener(_02), normal_skill_trigger(_02), combo_skill_trigger(_02), ultimate_skill_ontarget_listener, finishball, finishball_03, train_lastcombo_with_ball, atk_buff_normal_skill and combo_skill_listener are created only by each other, the unused abentity_onfield02 or a training stage: no effect.

Operator HP isn't simulated (N2, deferred; owner 2026-10-20: operators count as topped up by auto-heals), so the controlled operator is taken to be at Max HP when the crystal treats it and every treatment gives the crystal's Arts Amp (U1, in-game test 70). Heal amounts aren't modelled (heal events only).

stacks.label: Auxiliary Crystal: HP treatments used (of 2)
stacks.note: buff_chr_0011_seraph_combo_count on the crystal (stackingType 3, max 2, 10 s): whether a layer expires before the second treatment is U2 / B4 (in-game test 70); interim: it doesn't. Reset when a new crystal comes out (crystal_out).

buffs.label: Auxiliary Crystal out (until its 2 treatments or 20 s)
buffs.note: chr_0011_seraph_normal_skill_abentity_onfield, spawned at the controlled operator by buff_chr_0011_seraph_spawnball's first 1 s tick (cast frame 7 + 30). Its AuraAction (entity frames 1-901, radius 99, characters) gives every team member buff_chr_0011_seraph_normal_skill_heal; at entity frame 600 it ends unless its treatments are used up (finishball_02 → FinishOwnerAction), then finishball_04 ends it 6 s later (the engine's combo window; nothing else reads the lingering crystal, so the kit ends this marker when the treatments are used up). A state only; no modifiers.

buffs.label: Auxiliary Crystal: Arts Amp on the treated controlled operator
buffs.note: buff_chr_0011_seraph_mainchr_heal, after its HealAction: CheckHp (compare 3, ratio 1.0: at Max HP) on the controlled operator → buff_chr_0011_seraph_potential_1_atkup (stackingType 2 max 1: refreshed, "cannot stack") → EnhancedAction subType 1 (all four Arts elements) rate atk_up (0.15 at level 12, P1 +0.05) for buff_duration (25 s). Logged as buff_common_affixes_enhance_spell 0.16 on Si in zmdlogs-abfd4b7478ec (0.11 at level 7 + 0.05). HP isn't simulated: the treated operator counts as at Max HP, so every treatment gives it (N2 interim, U1). Given to the treated operator only (to: eventSubject).

buffs.label: Execute Process: Cryo DMG Taken (talent 1)
buffs.note: Talent 1: "Hitting an enemy with Cryo Infliction or Solidification also causes the enemy to suffer Cryo DMG Taken +{cryst_up} for {duration}s. This effect cannot stack." buff_chr_0011_seraph_talent_1_crystup: DamageScaleProcessor side 1 NormalCalcZone + cryst_up on CheckDamageType 4 (Cryo); stackingType 2 max 1 (refreshed). cryst_up (0.07 / 0.10) and duration (5) are the combo's keys after the talent's skillBbModifier; created only on the combo's vs_cryo branch, which needs the talent.

buffs.label: Stack Overflow: team Cryo and Nature Amp
buffs.note: buff_chr_0011_seraph_atk_buff (per recipient, stackingType 2 max 1): StoreAttributeValue attribute 41 (Intellect of the source, Xaihi) × wisd_up (its baseValue names atk_up without useBlackboardKey: 0), CompareFloat ≥ wisd_max → wisd_max, then SimpleCalcBB + atk_up; EnhancedAction subType 5 (Cryo) and 3 (Nature) for duration (12 s). The cap is on the Intellect part only: zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d logs 0.568052 = 0.264 + 921.37 × 0.00033 (P5 ×1.1 on all three keys; above the 0.396 cap), zmdlogs-abfd4b7478ec 0.301833 = 0.209 + 351.64 × 0.000264. Intellect is read when the buff is applied (frame 58), buffs included.

triggers.note: CreateBuffAction buff_chr_0011_seraph_spawnball at frame 7 (finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited: a skill Xaihi starts before its tick ends it); its first tick (triggerInterval 1 s, waitFirstTriggerInterval) at frame 37 spawns the crystal (and creates buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp: the skill's teamEnergy at 37). Not detached: dropped if the cast is cut before frame 37; a rotation step without `at` waits for it. A crystal still out is replaced and its count reset (U3, in-game test 70).

buff_chr_0011_seraph_normal_skill_heal (on each team member, from the crystal's aura) abilityEvent 302 (the member deals damage): CheckTimedMarkerCondition (its 0.3 s marker, per member: a Final Strike with two landings counts once), no finishball_04 yet, CheckMainCharacterCondition (the member is controlled), CheckDamageDecorateMask 2097152 (Final Strike) → buff_chr_0011_seraph_combo_count on the crystal (this gain) and buff_chr_0011_seraph_mainchr_heal on the member (crystal_heal).

Skill description: "After the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on the enemy, the Auxiliary Crystal will restore the said operator's HP. This effect can trigger 2 times." buff_chr_0011_seraph_mainchr_heal: first tick after 0.25 s (7.5 frames, taken as 8; waitFirstTriggerInterval): HealAction heal_value + will_up × Xaihi's Will (amounts aren't modelled) with heal tag -320297214 (the battle-skill tag Freedom to Proselytize checks), then the Max-HP Amp (always: N2 interim). Judged on the situation at the Final Strike, together with crystal_count (so its `if` sees the count before that gain).

COMBO TRIGGER (CharGrowthTable): "When the Auxiliary Crystal uses up its HP treatments." buff_chr_0011_seraph_combo_count buffEvent 6 at 2 layers: CreateBuff finishball_04 on the crystal (it lingers 6 s, no more treatments) and TriggerComboSkillAction for Xaihi. The engine's combo window is 6 s, as long as the crystal lingers.
The combo launches the crystal at frame 24 (CreateBuff finishball_02 on it: FinishOwnerAction). Matters only if a newer crystal is out by then.

Ultimate frame 58: CreateBuffAction buff_chr_0011_seraph_atk_buff and _atk_buff_2 (0.2 s, empty) on the team, inside its cantCastSkill / cantSwitchPosition channel 0-75, after the time stop 0-45. Talent 2's DispelAction (Cryo Infliction and Solidification on the team, if exist_talent_2) has no effect here: statuses on operators aren't simulated.

hits.note: LaunchProjectile at 10 → chr_0011_seraph_attack1_projhit: DamageAction atk_scale (mask 128, Cryo); ObtainCostAction atb (0 in SkillPatchTable) if controlled. Travel not counted (Ti2).

Two launches (7, 12), each one atk_scale landing (0.37 at level 12; display_atk_scale 0.74 is the sum; both logs have two equal hits per attack4); SP atb × 0.5 per landing (the projhit's ObtainCostAction literal 0.5).
DamageAction at 19, mask 2097280 (Final Strike: the crystal's treatment trigger); ObtainCostAction atb (15) if controlled; stagger poise (15) onlyEnableForMainChar.
DamageAction at 32, mask 132; BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 1.0 (no factor).
A rotation's dive: a jump, then this landing (batch-1 S10). DamageAction at 1, mask 1152.

skills.label: Battle skill: Distributed DoS
skills.note: No damage: summons the Auxiliary Crystal at frame 37 (trigger crystal_out) with the team energy (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp in the same spawnball tick; cut with the cast before 37). Frame 6's SP (if buff_chr_0011_seraph_talent_1_atb) is unreachable: no talent attaches that buff.

skills.label: Combo skill: Stress Testing
skills.note: The crystal (or Xaihi without one) launches at frame 24 → chr_0011_seraph_combo_skill_projhit; TimeDilationAction 0-24 and the window 25-60 from SkillData timing. HitStopAction 0.2 s (Ti1b) and InterruptAction 1 s on the enemy aren't modelled. P3's bounce (LaunchProjectile at one other enemy within 15 m) needs a second enemy. buff_chr_0011_seraph_combo_skill_tutorial_marker: tutorial only.

hits.label: On a Cryo-inflicted or Solidified enemy (talent 1 learned)
hits.note: combo_skill_projhit, first action: IfElse exist_talent_1 ≥ 1 and CheckTagMatch on the target (1570888476 Cryo Infliction, 1535684437 Solidified) → CreateBuff buff_chr_0011_seraph_talent_1_crystup on the target. It runs before this hit's own SpellInfliction, so it reads the enemy before the hit (a hit's `if`), and the debuff counts for this hit: zmdlogs-abfd4b7478ec combos at 19487, 57934, 99947 ms are ×1.089 = (1.12 + 0.10) / 1.12 over the one at 85032.

hits.label: Otherwise
hits.note: SpellInfliction type 2 (Cryo) before the DamageAction atk_scale (mask 12288, Cryo); poise unit poise (10); ObtainCostAction usp (10) if it hit. On a Cryo-inflicted enemy the infliction is an Arts Burst (a second later on the enemy's clock: A5).

skills.label: Ultimate: Stack Overflow
skills.note: No damage: the team Cryo and Nature Amp at frame 58 (trigger ultimate_amp). UltimateTimeAction 0-45, ChannelingCastingAction 0-75 and the window 67-100 from SkillData timing; buff_common_damage_immune_ult_skill (0-80) has no effect here.
